model.name: Diagram UX polish on the working R33.3 editor (add-shows / select-keeps-diagram / drag-no-pan / puml-populated)
model.description: Four UX refinements on the WORKING R33.3 interactive diagram editor (mostly reuse/wiring, no fork), from Tron device-QA (IMG_4778/4779). (1) Add-Diagram must refresh the tree so the new empty diagram node appears under diagrams/ immediately (POST /api/model/diagram/create already exists + mofChildren rawbin:diagram already enumerates Diagram units; the action just never refreshes). (2) Selecting a box IN the diagram must navigate/highlight that class in the TREE and KEEP the diagram in the drawer - it must NOT swap the drawer to class-detail (today box-click calls selectionModel.replaceWith -> drawer swaps, diagram gone); class-detail opens ONLY on a TREE click. (3) Dragging a SELECTED box must MOVE it with NO pan; pan happens only when nothing is selected (disambiguate by selection-state, not just target). (4) The puml/ folder must be populated with the project's .puml itemviews (today mofChildren rawbin:puml returns PumlArtifact units = none exist). Mixed CLIENT (items 1-3) + SERVER (item 4) -> real restart on ship. Architect design: design-mof-tree.md ## R33.5 (commit 1a39feb91), measure-first per item. INV-R33.5-1 add->shows / -2 diagram-stays / -3 drag-disambig / -4 puml-populated. ★ TRON-RESOLVED item 4 (2026-07-31) = option (a): puml/ enumerates the ~55 existing source .puml (sprints/*/diagrams/) as itemviews, click -> Import (R32.7 pumlToModel) -> interactive diagram.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (device-QA 2026-07-31, IMG_4778/4779): add-diagram should show the new diagram; selecting a class box in the diagram should not throw the diagram away (keep it, just highlight the class in the tree); dragging a selected box should move it, not pan; the puml folder is empty and should show the puml files.

discoverySource.flaggedBy: Tron device-QA (IMG_4778/4779) via robbin-po; architect measured-first design
discoverySource.note: 4 UX refinements on the R33.3 working editor. Architect measured each against current code (design-mof-tree.md ## R33.5, 1a39feb91). Mostly reuse/wiring: rb-diagram-detail box-click/drag, RbPanZoom (+ new setEnabled), rb-trace-tree revealNode + tree-refresh, mofChildren, /api/model/diagram/create, R32.7 pumlToModel/modelToPuml.

openDecisions.question: Which .puml set populates the puml/ folder itemviews?
openDecisions.optionA: Existing SOURCE .puml design files (the ~55 in scrum.pmo/sprints/*/diagrams/) - i.e. Import-PUML surface.
openDecisions.optionB: GENERATED puml-as-code per Diagram via R32.7 modelToPuml (puml generated from the M1 model, DRY with R32.7) - the vision's puml-as-code.
openDecisions.architectRecommendation: B (with A as the separate Import-PUML feature D).
openDecisions.note: Changes AC-puml-folder-populated + the item-4 method/Impl. Items 1-3 build independently while this is ruled.
openDecisions.resolutionNote: Tron ruled (a): enumerate the ~55 EXISTING SOURCE .puml design files (scrum.pmo/sprints/*/diagrams/) as itemviews under puml/; click -> Import (R32.7 pumlToModel) -> interactive diagram. Architect's rec (b) generated puml-as-code is NOT this AC (a later/separate concern).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clicking Add-Diagram creates an empty Diagram (POST /api/model/diagram/create) AND immediately refreshes the diagrams/ folder so the new diagram node APPEARS in the tree without a manual reload (reuse the rb-model-resynced / tree-reload pattern rb-trace-tree already listens to, or re-fetch /api/trace/children/rawbin:diagram + re-render that folder). The new empty diagram is ready to drop into.

Selecting a box inside the diagram sets a diagram-LOCAL selection (highlights the box) and navigates/highlights that class in the TREE (reuse the existing reveal - tree-reveal event / location.hash), but does NOT call selectionModel.replaceWith, so the shared selection is untouched and the drawer STAYS on the diagram. Class-detail opens ONLY on a TREE click (unchanged). In-diagram box-select is decoupled from the drawer detail-swap.

Pan is gated by SELECTION STATE: when a box is selected the canvas does NOT pan (RbPanZoom disabled via a new setEnabled(false) while a box is selected); dragging the selected box MOVES it (existing wireBoxDrag); dragging empty canvas (nothing selected) pans; clicking empty canvas clears the selection and re-enables pan. The selection-state gate subsumes the target-based edge that leaked pan @390.

The puml/ folder is POPULATED by enumerating the ~55 EXISTING SOURCE .puml design files (scrum.pmo/sprints/*/diagrams/) as itemviews (mirror the ts/ file enumeration in mofChildren rawbin:puml, server-side). Clicking an itemview IMPORTS that .puml (reuse the R32.7 pumlToModel parser, already imported server.ts:32) into an interactive diagram (the R33.3 editor). ★ TRON-DECIDED 2026-07-31 = option (a) existing source .puml; the generated puml-as-code (b, via R32.7 modelToPuml) is a separate later concern, NOT this AC. Server-side mofChildren change -> real restart on ship.

GATE @390 on Tron REAL interaction (screenshot + pixel, planted-defect bite - NOT 'loads'): (1) Add-Diagram -> new node appears under diagrams/; (2) select a box -> the tree highlights the class AND the diagram STAYS (drawer not swapped), class-detail only on tree-click; (3) drag a selected box -> it moves with NO pan, drag empty canvas -> it pans; (4) puml/ -> shows the .puml itemviews. Mixed client+server -> verified after a REAL server restart + boot-verify (R31.7 invariant).
